_note: The story that opens every reading. Plain and warm, told the way you'd tell it out loud. It is assembled from these lines by the chart: who sent you (the Atmakaraka), the costume (the rising sign, or the Sun's sign when the birth time is unknown), the gift and its shadow (the Moon's mansion, its shakti from corpus.json), and the houseguests (the Vimshottari periods, with the ages they arrive). Placeholders in curly braces are filled in by the site; keep them. Change any line and every reading changes with it.
TITLE: Prologue: How You Got Here
SUB: a silly story that turns out to be true, which the rest of the reading explains
OPENING: Before you were born{named} you waited your turn at the Well of Urðr, where the three Norns sit at the roots of the World Tree and spin everyone's thread. It was a long wait.
SOUL_INTRO: When you finally reached the front, Urðr, the eldest, opened her book to your page and read out who had sent you.

SOUL.Sun: The Sun sent you. You came here to be fully yourself, out in the open where people can see it, and that has never been quite as easy as it sounds.
SOUL.Moon: The Moon sent you. You came to look after people, and you took that so seriously that you sometimes forget you're allowed to be looked after too.
SOUL.Mars: Mars sent you. You came to do the brave thing, and you've never been very good at waiting for someone to tell you it's the right time.
SOUL.Mercury: Mercury sent you, with a message to deliver. You've been working out what it says ever since, and it keeps changing a little as you go.
SOUL.Jupiter: Jupiter sent you. You came to find out what's true and then pass it on, so you've been the student and the teacher more times than you can count.
SOUL.Venus: Venus sent you. You came to love something properly, all the way through, including the parts of it that are dull or hard.
SOUL.Saturn: Saturn sent you. You came to build something that lasts, and Saturn gave you the slow way to do it on purpose, because the slow way is the one that holds.

COSTUME_INTRO: Next, Verðandi took you to the dressing room, where there were rails and rails of costumes. You chose {costume}.
COSTUME_UNKNOWN: (Nobody wrote down the exact minute you arrived, so your costume is read from your Sun's sign instead. It still fits.)

COSTUME.Aries: a helmet that was a little too big, and you've been heading into things first ever since
COSTUME.Taurus: a heavy velvet cloak and a good pair of boots, because comfort mattered to you even then
COSTUME.Gemini: two costumes, because you couldn't settle on one, and you still switch between them depending on the day
COSTUME.Cancer: a shell that's hard on the outside and soft on the inside, with deep pockets for other people's things
COSTUME.Leo: a crown and a mane, and somehow a spotlight came with them
COSTUME.Virgo: a neat apron with a sewing kit in the pocket, in case something needed mending
COSTUME.Libra: something beautiful that went well with everyone else's, after asking a few people what they thought
COSTUME.Scorpio: a long dark coat with an inside pocket that nobody else gets to look in
COSTUME.Sagittarius: travelling clothes and a bow, already muddy from somewhere you hadn't been yet
COSTUME.Capricorn: a sensible old coat that looked like it had been in the family for generations
COSTUME.Aquarius: something nobody had worn before, which a few people in the queue said would never catch on
COSTUME.Pisces: a costume made mostly of water, which was beautiful and very hard to keep on

GIFT: Before you left, Verðandi packed you a gift. The label said {mansion}, and inside was {shakti}, which the old books call {shakti_name}. She folded its shadow into the same bag, because a gift and the ways it can go wrong always travel together. You found the shadow later. Everyone does.
TIMING_INTRO: The youngest Norn, Skuld, keeps the appointment book for everything still to come. Nobody is born into an empty house. There's always a planet already living there, and the others arrive one at a time, each one staying for years and changing how life feels while it's there.
FIRST: When you arrived, the house already had someone in it. It was {visitor}, and they stayed until you were {age}.
FIRST_BRIEF: When you arrived, the house already had someone in it, just on their way out. It was {visitor}, and they were gone before your first birthday.
NOW: That's who is living with you now.

VISITOR.Ketu: Ketu, who travels light and leaves you feeling you've done all this before
VISITOR.Venus: Venus, who stays for twenty years and brings beauty, pleasure and the people you'll love
VISITOR.Sun: the Sun, for a short, bright stretch that asks what you've made of yourself
VISITOR.Moon: the Moon, who stirs up your feelings and pulls you toward home
VISITOR.Mars: Mars, full of energy and looking for a project, or a fight
VISITOR.Rahu: Rahu, who is hungry for more and especially wants whatever you were told you couldn't have
VISITOR.Jupiter: Jupiter, who brings teachers, luck, growth and a lot to think about
VISITOR.Saturn: Saturn, who stays nineteen years and asks you to do things properly this time
VISITOR.Mercury: Mercury, who brings work, learning, conversation and long lists

CLOSING: And that's how you got here. It's a silly story, but it's true in the way that matters. Your costume is The Seat, your gift and its shadow are The Engine, whoever sent you is The Soul-Planet, and the houseguests, with the ages they arrive, are The Clock. The rest of this reading explains each part.
